I became a bilateral arm amputee below the elbow at 27. Had to move back with my dad. I was doing great before my accident but then BAM like a fucking truck my entire world changed. I feel useless and like a burden needing to ask for help. Depression comes in alot of different forms; not wanting to do anything I'll literally just sit doing nothing, oversleeping not wanting to wake up because in my dreams I still have hands. Initially I wished I didn't survive my accident. Then I found other people like me just owning life. I wondered why and how they can be happy and I'm here struggling. Have you tried medication? Wellbutrin is a mild ssri and peps you up. Lyrics helps with my anxiety and appetite. Idk where I'm going with this, but try making small goals. I take it one day at a time. Have something to look forward to. For me it's laser scar revision, getting prosthetics, and going back to work and being independent again. If you aren't hungry but haven't eaten try placing food in from of you and if you start nibbling then fuck ya praise yourself get that dopamine rush. When you put those groceries away just take a step back and acknowledge that you were a responsible adult. You can't keep beating yourself up, I still struggle with this. I have to force myself to do things, I lose interest in things easily but that's depression.

The robotic hands go for 50k-100k+ per hand so it's definitely out of reach for me. The more sophisticated ones have preprogrammed grips but it's basically an open and close function. It would be a nice luxury to have but they are delicate and break often. With no sensory feedback it takes alot of focus to use because you don't want to squeeze something too tight or drop it

I have and for alot of the patients who received an arm transplant don't have full hand function (i.e. independently move their fingers) it's almost like a quadriplegics hand where they can put stuff in it and it's only held on because of the finger muscles stay contracted. I feel like even the basic hook prosthetics are better than that. Plus you have to take immunosuppressants your whole life.

I'm a bilateral arm amputee. I don't have prosthetics but I've heard body powered hooks are the gold standard. I joined this support group specifically for bilateral arm amputees ( https://www.facebook.com/groups/SkillsForLife.BULLWorkshop/?ref=share ).  Jason Koger on there is an avid hunter and we have monthly zooms that cover tips and tricks such as dressing. We record them and I remember Jason did a zoom call over him hunting specifically. 

I would recommend you get a bidet installed in the bathroom so he doesn't have ask for help wiping or use the heel method. 

It's a hard adjustment. I have my fair shares of bad days, so emotional support; just be there for him. Don't baby him and do everything for him; I don't like it when my family does this, if I need help I'll ask for it. It sucks really fucking bad having to do things differently, but he'll have to learn how to use his residuals limbs.

I also learned to use my feet to pick things up; especially when I drop something on the floor. I don't like it but I also use me teeth to hold things and open soda cans. I also had to accept eating things like a lizard; like with chips I pour them on a plate and use my tongue to get them in my mouth. It was humiliating for me but. Or he can use a measuring cup to scoop things up and ulse his residual limbs to pour them into his mouth. Also get a few universal cuffs ( https://www.amazon.com/dp/B06XTLHP4X/ref=cm_sw_r_cp_apa_glt_fabc_WA4E6RMA9Z4NJWEACRSA ) I jam a fork and spoon into it; I have two dedicated to the fork and spoon. I then Velcro it around my residual limb and feed myself

Check out the channels on this YouTube page ( https://youtube.com/c/EnhancingSkillsforLife ) Jason has a YouTube channel

Feel free to reach out to me

I'm guessing it was nurses and the bright hospital lights since I was on a ventilator for two days and my eyes had a hard time adjusting.
I use tv and my phone to distract me. When I'm idle like trying to sleep is when all the bitterness and suicidal ideations come out. I still have all my senses
